hooks.prompt: Before the session ends, update the active agent memory files for this repo. Prefer `.agent/patterns.md` and `.agent/changelog.md`; if those do not exist, fall back to `.claude/patterns.md` and `.claude/changelog.md`; if neither location exists, create `.agent/patterns.md` and `.agent/changelog.md`. Keep `patterns.md` short: durable repo-specific conventions, gotchas, and workflow rules only; target about 12 short bullets or <= 600 tokens; prune stale or duplicate entries; do not copy changelog history or temporary task notes into it. Then merge today's concise session notes into the existing `## YYYY-MM-DD` section in `changelog.md`. Keep both files concise and actionable.
